items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: And I played brass band with him.

ctx.x: Well, yeah. Well, he had a good lip. I mean. Yeah. A good lip. A tisimal lip. But he had a wonderful lip. Yeah. For the Raid that was trumpet. He had a wonderful lip. Mm-hmm. Wonderful. And I played brass band with him. You remember when they played the WPA band?
They came here. They played for them people from Washington. At the Hume Center one Sunday evening. That was the last time I heard little job play. Yeah.
